everythingThatWorksWithFreero: Everything that works with Freero, and the one step that connects it. Any MCP client works with every board you can open, acting as you with only the permissions you give it.
integrationsPeopleBuiltOnFreero: Integrations people built on Freero’s MCP server and API, listed after a review. Freero doesn’t run them: each signs in with the permissions you grant it.
couldNotLoadTheCommunity: Could not load the community listings. Reload the page to try again.
builtABotASync: Built a bot, a sync or an agent on Freero’s MCP server, REST API or webhooks? Submit it: once a reviewer approves it, everyone on this Freero finds it here.
freeroWorksWithAnyMcp: Freero works with any MCP client, so an assistant or coding agent that isn’t listed usually connects the same way, with your server’s MCP address. A tool with webhooks or an API can use Freero’s REST API and webhooks.
thisIsSetUpBy: This is set up by a team’s owner or admin in its admin console. You don’t administer a team here, so ask one of your team’s admins, or create a team from your boards page.
onlyYouAndFreeroS: Only you and Freero’s reviewers can see it until it is approved.
everyoneSignedInToThis: Everyone signed in to this Freero can find it on the Apps & agents page.
nobodyElseSeesItWithdraw: Nobody else sees it. Withdraw it and submit it again once the reviewer’s points are addressed.
itsDeveloperBuiltItOn: Its developer built it on {builtOnText}. Follow their instructions on their site.
itSignsInWithIts: It signs in with its OAuth app “{name}”: Freero’s consent screen shows what it asks for, and you can disconnect it any time in Settings → Connected apps.
thanksForYourReportFreero: Thanks for your report. Freero’s moderators will review it.
yourReportCouldNotBe: Your report could not be sent. Try again.
tellFreeroSModeratorsWhat: Tell Freero’s moderators what is wrong. Its developer isn’t told who reported it.
theWebsiteMustBeAn: The website must be an https:// link.
theDocsLinkMustBe: The docs link must be an https:// link.
tickWhatItIsBuilt: Tick what it is built on.
couldNotSubmitItTry: Could not submit it. Try again.
writeItAsPlainText: Write it as plain text: links and formatting aren’t shown. Everyone signed in to this Freero reads it once it is approved.
name: Name
whatItDoesForSomeone: What it does for someone, in one sentence.
freeroSModeratorsRemovedIt: Freero’s moderators removed it; nobody else sees it. The email they sent has a link to appeal.
freeroReviewedThisListingNot: Freero reviewed this listing, not the integration’s code. Give it only the permissions it needs; you can revoke them any time in Settings.
submittedAReviewerWillLook: Submitted. A reviewer will look at it; you’ll get an email with the decision.
builtSomethingOnFreeroS: Built something on Freero’s MCP server, REST API or webhooks? List it on the Apps & agents page. A reviewer checks each submission first; until then only you see it. Approved listings carry a Community label.
